narrative.text: At the close of October 2, 2026, the US labor report showed September payrolls rising by 29,000 and unemployment at 4.2%. BLS described both as little changed. The S&P 500 nevertheless finished the session 0.73% higher, according to Reuters.
Company news supplied a weaker counterpoint. Reuters reported a 3.6% decline in Nike and highlighted China demand weakness.

Energy security supplied another major narrative. G7 leaders announced a coordinated 100 million barrel release through the IEA. The statement describes an announced supply measure; implementation remains to be assessed.

script.text: This is the October second market wrap. September payrolls rose by twenty-nine thousand, while unemployment was four point two percent. BLS called both little changed. Reuters reported the S and P five hundred closed zero point seven three percent higher.
Company news was less uniform: Nike fell three point six percent, with Reuters flagging China demand weakness.

Meanwhile, G7 leaders announced a coordinated hundred million barrel energy release through the IEA. That is a commitment, not proof of completed delivery. These are distinct stories; a higher index does not settle every risk.
